RegistrationInfo.Description: 03:15 daily: the six tree-wide ratchets a push no longer pays for (ops/run-daily-ratchets.ps1). Brad, 2026-09-12. They cost 184s of a 699s push and audit-mustfire-census alone, at 54s, was the wall-clock floor - no pool finishes sooner than its longest single job. What they protect is the estate's own guard quality over months: a deleted must-fire fixture, a self-test resting on an unfrozen rulings file, a stray control byte, a write-only report family, a walk that breaks inside worktrees, a statement keyword glued onto a command line. None of them can put a wrong number in front of a paying reader, so learning about one the next morning costs a morning. It is NOT a nightly full gate sweep, which Brad refused: six named audits, about 100s. The names are not listed here or in the runner - they are read from ops/run-gates.ps1's own entries marked daily, the same mark that makes a push skip them, so the two can never disagree. Runs THROUGH ops/run-once-a-day.ps1 like brain-digest, recall-sleep and daemon-battery: the wrapper owns the transcript a hidden task owes (ops/audit-run-log-claims.ps1) and the once-a-day stamp, so the runner needs no reach into grocery/ and ops/audit-cross-module-reach.ps1 stays at its baseline. 03:15 sits clear of the 02:30 daemon battery and the 04:35 recall sleep.
